purpose: Fixed public-rule terrain for asset State progression. Battle traces are later joined to this schedule; no Battle explanation or policy preference is encoded here.

time_coordinate.origin: productive State-entry day recorded by the public world (planted_day or placed_day)
time_coordinate.day_boundary_rule: Yield schedules are keyed to origin calendar day, not elapsed wall-clock hours from the entry turn.
time_coordinate.default_turn_range_note: With 24 turns/day and entry_hour in 0..23, an offset N boundary is N*24 down to N*24-23 turns away.

harvest_to_carried_inventory.trigger: successful HARVEST on an eligible tile with yield_units > 0
harvest_to_carried_inventory.result: all held yield_units move to that unit's private carried inventory
harvest_to_carried_inventory.crop_ongoing_tile_after: plant remains with yield_units reset to 0
harvest_to_carried_inventory.animal_tile_after: animal remains with yield_units reset to 0

conditions: DROP while standing on a shed-adjacent access tile moves carried inventory into shed up to shed capacity.
PLACE <item> [n] while shed-adjacent can deposit that item into shed up to shed capacity.
End-of-day automatically drops all per-unit carried inventories into shed up to shed capacity; overflow is discarded.
carried_inventory_to_sellable_shed.reason_no_fixed_offset: Movement / shed-adjacency and chosen unit actions are Battle-path dependent.

sellable_shed_to_cash.condition: SELL consumes units from private shed only.
sellable_shed_to_cash.note: Dynamic market price and realized Cash are intentionally excluded from Asset State Schedule v0.

acquisition.note: Seed cost is a public rule parameter, not a valuation score.

survival.rule: At each end-of-day: watered_today resets consecutive_unwatered to 0; otherwise it increments by 1; plant becomes WEED at >=2.
survival.planting_day_implication: Because entry initializes consecutive_unwatered=1, a newly planted crop must be watered before its first end-of-day refresh to survive that refresh.

end_of_life.decay_rule: From max_lifespan_step, every 2 turns yield_units decreases by 1; tile becomes WEED when yield_units <= 0.
end_of_life.successful_harvest_effect: Nonongoing crop tile becomes empty immediately.

acquisition.note: Seed cost is a public rule parameter, not a valuation score.

survival.rule: Same crop survival rule: plant becomes WEED after reaching 2 consecutive end-of-day unwatered counts.
survival.planting_day_implication: Newly planted MELON must be watered before its first end-of-day refresh to survive that refresh.

end_of_life.decay_rule: From max_lifespan_step, every 2 turns yield_units decreases by 1; tile becomes WEED when yield_units <= 0.
end_of_life.successful_harvest_effect: Nonongoing crop tile becomes empty immediately.

acquisition.note: Seed cost is a public rule parameter, not a valuation score.

survival.rule: Same crop survival rule: plant becomes WEED after reaching 2 consecutive end-of-day unwatered counts.
survival.planting_day_implication: Newly planted STRAWBERRY must be watered before its first end-of-day refresh to survive that refresh.

production.successful_harvest_effect: Plant remains; held yield resets to 0; later scheduled production events can still occur.

end_of_life.decay_rule: After final scheduled production event, decay begins at the next day boundary; every 2 turns held yield drops by 1 and tile becomes WEED at <=0.

pre_entry_path: PLACE COW on matching unoccupied PASTURE

survival.rule: At each end-of-day: fed_today resets consecutive_unfed to 0; otherwise it increments by 1; animal escapes at >=2 and the PASTURE remains.
survival.minimum_survival_statement: One unfed end-of-day can be survived; two consecutive unfed end-of-day refreshes cause escape.
survival.care: CARE is optional for bonus production and is not required for survival.

production.care_bonus_rule: A day with both CARE and FEED adds one pending_care_bonus after that day's production processing. On a later fed production day, pending bonus is consumed and added to the base unit.
production.output_event_day_formula: placed_day + 8 + n*2 for n >= 0 while the animal survives

pre_entry_path: PLACE SHEEP on matching unoccupied PASTURE

survival.rule: At each end-of-day: fed_today resets consecutive_unfed to 0; otherwise it increments by 1; animal escapes at >=2 and the PASTURE remains.
survival.minimum_survival_statement: One unfed end-of-day can be survived; two consecutive unfed end-of-day refreshes cause escape.
survival.care: CARE is optional for bonus production and is not required for survival.

production.care_bonus_rule: A day with both CARE and FEED adds one pending_care_bonus after that day's production processing. On a later fed production day, pending bonus is consumed and added to the base unit.
production.output_event_day_formula: placed_day + 6 + n*3 for n >= 0 while the animal survives

excluded_from_v0: Dynamic market price and realized Cash value
CARROT, TOMATO, GOOSE until needed by Battle evidence
boundary: This file is World-side master data derived only from public rules.
It describes legal State progression; it does not claim that a Battle will execute required WATER/FEED/HARVEST/DROP actions.
Fixed acquisition costs are raw public rule parameters and are not combined into an asset value score.
Price and SELL behavior belong to a separate Market Map.
Battle traces must be joined later as Asset Instances; they do not mutate this schedule.
